name: Emergency access accounts (break-glass accounts)
short_description: Highly privileged emergency admin accounts kept outside Conditional Access policies and protected with long passwords and phishing-resistant MFA, so administrators can regain access to a tenant if they are locked out.

evidence.quote: Break-glass accounts. These are emergency admin accounts that you keep outside of your conditional access policies.
Ein Notfallkonto bewahrt Sie vor diesem Albtraum.
Breakglass accounts are the emergency access pattern.
I did extensive automation around break glass accounts.
A global support team needs emergency access, so you create break-class accounts with broad roles.
